data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 1554 (04933de298, Change-Id I7a820c313f94abe14743e0b217b5ebf9e027ac48) after fetching and fast-forwarding to origin/main b7d29e58c7; pre-push behind count was 0. TDD evidence: initial oracle RED 6/12, implementation cycles reached 12/12 held-out green; defect-seeded mutations independently broke route forwarding and lock bypass. Quality review added a RED exact-failure-tally regression before the fix. Post-base-update validation: 202 focused bridge/reconciler tests, 19 ADR numbering/index tests, make lint, make typecheck, ADR generators/checks. Full default suite was delegated to CI per operator instruction after its only early stale preview-lock expectations were corrected in targeted suites.
